status: design-prepared; graph-only audit passed; model evaluation not started
authorization_scope: Design true fact addition using existing models, with novel fact in either hop. No new foundation or writer training and no new overwrite of existing facts.

parent.historical_overwrite_states: Read-only reference only; never generate new overwrites in this batch
parent.writer_training_scope: Outer training used corrections of existing keys only; absence-key addition is an untrained writing condition

panel.novelty: Original graph lookup[head,relation] == -1; absent from original atomic, chain and correction keys. Existing entity/relation vocabulary only.
panel.paired_roles: One novel fact and one final fast state per case, evaluated in both hop positions
panel.historical_match: Same head and new tail as historical overwrite; replace the relation with an absent key. Preserve all original second-hop query prefixes.

writer.state_initialization: Independent A0 for every fact; never carry additions across cases
writer.query_context: Fresh native query with fast state only; no record, previous hidden state or previous KV cache

comparison: A0, before the new fact is supplied
A4, after four atomic-only TTCD writes of the new fact
A0 with the atomic record in the long window, as a reader prerequisite reference
Existing overwrite diagnostics, descriptive reference only; changed relation and prior exposure prevent pure conflict attribution

primary: Novel atomic final answer and EOS
New-to-old two-hop final answer and EOS
Old-to-new two-hop final answer and EOS
evaluation.readout_head: Original tied output embedding and final LayerNorm; full-vocabulary argmax, top5, truth probability and rank
evaluation.explicit_two_step_reference: Use the model's own first atomic final answer as the next head; same A4, no oracle substitution; record non-entity output as failure
evaluation.prerequisites: Read every known companion atomic fact at A0 and A4; also read the actual bridge inside each two-hop query
evaluation.conditional_subsets: Report full panel first, then subsets with A0-correct companion, A4-correct companion, atomic-final-correct, atomic-round1-correct and actual-bridge-correct. Report each intersection and its coverage; zero denominator is NA.

statistics.primary_aggregation: Mean per-fact accuracy; also report pooled numerator/denominator

evaluation.baseline_spontaneously_correct_facts: Retain and report separately; absence of training exposure does not imply the unedited model cannot guess correctly

execution_preparation.runner_status: Not implemented; no launch command exists yet
execution_preparation.engineering_development: Packet visibility, model freeze, readout isolation, source/weight identity and save/reload checks on eight development keys; no formal-query selection or parameter tuning
execution_preparation.preferred_device: CPU FP32; actual available CPU/memory checked before execution; no GPU reservation at design stage
execution_preparation.poor_scientific_outcome: Retain and report, including premise failures; never retrain foundation or expand write budget automatically
